info.title: Patrice API
info.description:
Error codes and their HTTP statuses:

- `UNAUTHENTICATED` (401): No valid session
- `INVALID_CREDENTIALS` (401): Email or password is wrong
- `DISCORD_NO_ACCOUNT` (401): No Patrice account is linked to this Discord account
- `FORBIDDEN` (403): The access engine denied the action
- `CSRF_FAILED` (403): Missing or invalid CSRF token
- `EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED` (403): Login requires a verified email address
- `INVALID_PASSCODE` (403): The invitation passcode is wrong
- `EMAIL_MISMATCH` (403): The email does not match the invitation
- `ROLE_NOT_GRANTABLE` (403): The inviter may not grant this role
- `NOT_FOUND` (404): Not found
- `RECORD_NOT_FOUND` (404): The record was removed while the request ran
- `ATTACHMENT_NOT_FOUND` (404): Attachment not found
- `CLAIMANT_NOT_FOUND` (404): That user does not hold a seat on this task
- `CONNECTION_NOT_FOUND` (404): Integration connection not found
- `DIVISION_NOT_FOUND` (404): Division not found
- `GRANT_NOT_FOUND` (404): Grant not found
- `INVITE_NOT_FOUND` (404): Invitation not found
- `MAPPING_NOT_FOUND` (404): Group mapping not found
- `MESSAGE_NOT_FOUND` (404): Message not found
- `PARENT_NOT_FOUND` (404): The parent message was not found
- `REQUEST_TEMPLATE_NOT_FOUND` (404): Request template not found
- `ROLE_NOT_FOUND` (404): Role not found
- `SESSION_NOT_FOUND` (404): Session not found
- `SUBMISSION_NOT_FOUND` (404): Submission not found
- `TASK_NOT_FOUND` (404): Task not found
- `TEAM_NOT_FOUND` (404): Team not found
- `USER_NOT_FOUND` (404): User not found
- `CONFLICT` (409): Conflict
- `ALREADY_EXISTS` (409): That value is already in use
- `REFERENCE_CONFLICT` (409): Another record still references this one, or a referenced record is gone
- `STALE_VERSION` (409): The record changed since it was read; reload and retry
- `ALREADY_CLAIMED` (409): You already hold a seat on this task
- `ALREADY_RETIRED` (409): Already retired
- `ALREADY_SUBMITTED` (409): A submission is already awaiting review
- `CLAIMS_CLOSED` (409): The task is not accepting claims
- `DISCORD_ALREADY_LINKED` (409): This Discord account belongs to another user
- `IDENTITY_TAKEN` (409): That sign-in account already belongs to another user
- `PROVIDER_ALREADY_CONNECTED` (409): A different account from this provider is already connected
- `DIVISION_RETIRED` (409): Division is retired
- `DUPLICATE_CONNECTION` (409): That workspace is already connected
- `DUPLICATE_MAPPING` (409): That mapping already exists
- `EMAIL_TAKEN` (409): That email address is already in use
- `INVALID_OPENINGS` (409): Openings cannot go below the active claimant count
- `INVALID_TRANSITION` (409): The submission is not in a state that allows this
- `INVITE_RACE_LOST` (409): The invitation was used concurrently
- `LAST_ADMIN` (409): Refused: this would remove the last administrator
- `LAST_AUTH_METHOD` (409): Refused: this would remove your only sign-in method
- `MESSAGE_RETIRED` (409): Message is retired
- `NOT_A_MEMBER` (409): The user does not hold that role
- `NOT_CLAIMED` (409): You do not hold a seat on this task
- `NOT_REVIVABLE` (409): Not retired, or past the grace period
- `NO_OPENINGS` (409): Every seat on the task is taken
- `OPENINGS_LOCKED` (409): Openings are locked for this division
- `REQUEST_TEMPLATE_LOCKED` (409): The request template is locked by a submission
- `STALE_SUBMISSION` (409): The submission changed since it was read
- `SUBMISSION_RETIRED` (409): Submission is retired
- `TASK_RETIRED` (409): Task is retired
- `TEAM_RETIRED` (409): Team is retired
- `USER_RETIRED` (409): User is retired
- `GONE` (410): No longer available
- `INVITE_UNAVAILABLE` (410): The invitation is expired, revoked or used up
- `TOKEN_INVALID` (410): The link is invalid, expired or already used
- `VALIDATION_FAILED` (422): The request body or parameters failed validation
- `UNPROCESSABLE` (422): Unprocessable entity
- `DISCORD_NOT_CONFIGURED` (422): Discord sign-in is not configured
- `FILE_TOO_LARGE` (422): The upload exceeds the size limit
- `INVALID_SUBMISSION` (422): The answers do not satisfy the request template
- `NO_DEFAULT_REQUEST_TEMPLATE` (422): The division has no request template
- `GOVERNANCE_ROLE_NOT_MAPPABLE` (422): A role holding governance grants cannot be mapped to an external group
- `NO_FILE` (422): No file was uploaded
- `TEAM_NOT_IN_DIVISION` (422): The team belongs to a different division than the task
- `NOT_LINKED` (422): The account is not linked
- `REPLY_TO_REPLY` (422): Threads are one level deep
- `ROLE_RETIRED` (422): Role is retired
- `WRONG_PASSWORD` (422): The current password is wrong
- `TOO_MANY_REQUESTS` (429): Rate limit exceeded
- `INTERNAL` (500): Internal server error
- `ERROR` (500): Unclassified error
- `QUEUE_UNAVAILABLE` (503): Background jobs are unavailable; try again later
